metadata.description: Starter marketplace of role-based plugins for knowledge workers. Copy, edit the markdown, install.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Plan your day, keep a clean task list, and run a weekly review using your calendar, email, chat, and project tracker, or plain pasted text.

plugins.name: sales
plugins.description: Prep calls, review deals, and draft follow-ups using your CRM, email, calendar, and call recordings, or uploaded notes.

plugins.name: customer-support
plugins.description: Triage tickets, draft consistent replies, and package clean escalations using your support platform and knowledge base.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: Write PRDs, prioritize roadmap candidates, and synthesize customer feedback using your tracker, design files, analytics, and docs.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Plan campaigns, draft on-brand content, and report on performance using your CRM, analytics, design, and email marketing tools.

plugins.name: legal
plugins.description: Review contracts against your playbook, triage NDAs, and explain clauses in plain language. Assistive analysis for attorney review, not legal advice.

plugins.name: finance
plugins.description: Explain variances, prepare journal entries for review, and track month-end close using your data warehouse and spreadsheets.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Write and check SQL, profile datasets, and turn results into clear stories for stakeholders using your warehouse and BI tools.

plugins.name: enterprise-search
plugins.description: Ask one question and search chat, docs, email, and tickets together, with sources, dates, and honest confidence.

plugins.name: bio-research
plugins.description: Search the literature, look up targets and compounds, and map clinical trial landscapes using PubMed, bioRxiv, ChEMBL, Open Targets, and ClinicalTrials.gov. For research use only.

plugins.name: plugin-management
plugins.description: Create, customize, and audit plugins in this repo. Helps team leads add company terminology, swap connectors, and keep plugins healthy.
